title: Samsung RF260B — Test mode entry
description: Enter test mode for manual operation and forced defrost (§4-1-1).

steps.title: Enter test mode
steps.body: Press Power Freezer + Fridge keys simultaneously for 8 seconds — all display segments turn off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Power Freezer + Fridge keys simultaneously for 8 seconds — all display segments turn off.

steps.title: Test mode sequence
steps.body: Within 15 s press any key to cycle: FF (manual op 1) → OF-r (manual op 2) → rd (R defrost) → fd (F+R defrost). Power cycle cancels.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Within 15 s press any key to cycle: FF (manual op 1) → OF-r (manual op 2) → rd (R defrost) → fd (F+R defrost). Power cycle cancels.

steps.title: Self-diagnostic entry
steps.body: During normal operation: Power Freezer + Power Fridge 8 s → ding-dong → self-diagnostic LEDs 30 s (§4-1-3).
steps.sourceExcerpt: During normal operation: Power Freezer + Power Fridge 8 s → ding-dong → self-diagnostic LEDs 30 s (§4-1-3).
